input_domain: every string of 0 to 11 characters, each of any value except 0, followed by the terminator; the characters after the terminator are of any value
limitations: parse_numeric_servname alone, for strings of at most 11 characters; callers, locale and errno are not examined; the model reads strtol as the stand-in in the prelude, which is exact for base 10 only and does not set errno, and the replay of a counterexample calls the C library; the expected value is computed for white space, a sign and decimal digits as C11 7.22.1.4 reads them, and the case does not say that the function should accept white space or a sign; a bound of 12 on every loop
